games.name: Egg Toss [2 Players]
games.desc:
👍 LIKE the game and join the group to get Free Fossil Egg!
🥚 Don't let your team's egg fall short or overshoot the catch.

How to play: 
- Pair up with your friend and choose your team.
- Toss and catch the egg to keep your team in the game.
- Distance between the pair gets farther with each successful catch.

⭐ 2 Game Modes to have fun
Classic - Start with one egg only. The last team with an unbroken egg wins!
Survival -  Get a new egg every round and outlast deadly lava. The last team standing wins!

🔥 Earn wins to unlock egg skins and climb the leaderboard!

games.name: [UPD7☠️] Survive the Elevator
games.desc:
You awaken in a place that should not exist—a tower stretching endlessly into a starless sky. The air hums with a strange, living pulse, and the only way forward is an ancient elevator waiting in silence, as if it’s been expecting you.

They call it Nowhere Tower—a realm between worlds where time fractures and reality bleeds. Each floor below twists into something new: forgotten ruins, warped memories, and creatures that should never have been. Something deep beneath calls your name. 

Step inside… and descend into the dark. 👍⬆️

⬆️Update 7:
✨ Extraction Feature: Take items back to the lobby at any time during playthrough.
✨ Item Storage Feature: Store your items in a safe within the lobby.
✨ Imbue Weapons: You can now imbue weapons.
✨ Elevator Storage Feature: A new storage system.
✨ New Rooms: 5 New Standard Rooms.
✨ Full economy rebalancing and distribution.

🛗🛗🛗🛗🛗
Stay tuned for updates! We update weekly!
